units.source_text: 小宠犬是英国的船员带进来的。

en.t: The little pet dog had been brought in by English sailors.

units.source_text: 横滨的一家宠物狗商店的朋友虽然看过了，但觉得还不算是好品种的硬毛小猎狗，因此不想引进。

en.t: A friend from a pet dog shop in Yokohama had seen it, but he did not think it was a good breed of wire-haired terrier, so he did not want to bring it in.

units.source_text: 由于没有十分把握，买卖人也就不敢贸然出手。

en.t: Because he was not completely sure, the dealer did not dare to act rashly.

units.source_text: 夫人赶巧听说此事，随即和附近的狗店老板一起，追到神户买了下来。

en.t: The lady happened to hear about it, and at once went with the owner of a nearby dog shop, followed it all the way to Kobe, and bought it.
